# Decoder test fixtures

These JPEG fixtures are copied unchanged from the Go 1.26.5 distribution's `src/image/testdata` directory and are used only by the `decode` package tests. They are © The Go Authors and distributed under the BSD-3-Clause license reproduced in [LICENSE-go](LICENSE-go).

| Fixture | Go source file | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `baseline.jpeg` | `video-001.q50.420.jpeg` | Baseline (sequential) 4:2:0 JPEG, 150 × 103 px |
| `progressive.jpeg` | `video-001.q50.420.progressive.jpeg` | Progressive encoding of the same picture |
| `cmyk.jpeg` | `video-001.cmyk.jpeg` | Adobe CMYK JPEG, exercising the CMYK reorientation path |

Every other fixture — PNG variants, damaged and truncated files, EXIF orientation segments, and oversized headers — is generated by the tests themselves.
